decision: Selected the centroid of the union of the four Sarpy County condominium-unit parcels of the Midlands Data Center Condominium at 11425 S 84th St, Papillion (units 1-4, parcels 011591834, 011591835, 011591836 and 011591837) as the locator of TierPoint's Omaha - Midlands (MID) data center at 11425 South 84th Street.

selected_properties.layer: Sarpy County's 'Sarpy_Parcels_WFL1' TaxParcel layer on ArcGIS Online (item aa96e67379a843c088b7809e43cb847d, source 'Sarpy County, Nebraska', CC0-1.0, listed on the county GIS hub gis.sarpy.gov; data last edited 9 December 2023)

computed.unit_polygon_structure: Units 1 and 3 share one rectangle and units 2 and 4 share the adjoining rectangle (identical rings), so the four units are drawn as two stacked schematic rectangles of about 468 m2 each.

unparcelled_lot.description: The unit polygons lie in a closed area that no other parcel in a 0.0065 x 0.004 degree window covers; it is enclosed by Huntington Park Replat 5 Lot 1 and other Huntington Park parcels, and no 'Lot 2 Huntington Park Replat 5' parcel exists in the layer, so it is taken to be the condominium regime's land.

cross_check_point.source: TierPoint structured-data GeoCoordinates on the Omaha - Midlands page

computed.method: Polygons returned with outSR=4326; union and centroid computed in EPSG:26914 (NAD83 / UTM 14N) and returned to WGS84, cross-checked in EPSG:32614 and 32615; geodesic areas on the WGS84 ellipsoid. The surrounding-parcel query omitted owner fields.

identity_bridge: TierPoint's page gives 'Omaha - Midlands (MID) 11425 South 84th Street Papillion, NE 68046' for its Omaha (Midlands) data center and colocation facility.

A Sarpy County parcel query for site addresses beginning '11425 S 84' returns exactly the four units of the MIDLANDS DATA CENTER CONDOMINIUM (suites 1-4, 25% each); units 3 and 4 are owned by TierPoint Properties LLC and units 1 and 2 by Alegent Health (a health-system organisation).
TierPoint's structured-data point lies 27 m east of the selected centroid, inside the same unparcelled condominium lot; it is a cross-check only.
unresolved: The county draws the condominium units schematically; the building footprint and TierPoint's share of it are not published, so the point locates the data-centre condominium property, not a suite.
The county layer is a December 2023 snapshot; the condominium and building predate it.
nearby_records: No Atlas site, project, source record, identity-mapping entry, pending fragment, claim or hold coordinate lies within 2 km; the nearest Atlas record is TierPoint Omaha - Bellevue, about 10.7 km north-east.

consistency_checks.datum: WGS84 output from the hosted service (outSR=4326)
